item.title: Welcome to Paradise: Key Global Developments on 26 October 2026
item.description: This episode covers major global news including Brazil's historic presidential election, escalating tensions in the Middle East with Israeli operations in Hebron, severe storms impacting the UK, a significant NHS doctors' strike looming in England, and the AI company Anthropic's blockbuster IPO revealing both promise and risks.
